risk_note: RV2 (commission). createCommissionSnapshot writes the commission snapshot inside the caller's Kysely transaction (BR-CALC-10): reads the app's published, unrevoked rule versions FOR SHARE, picks by paid_at (BR-CALC-11, seconds, inclusive; earlier than the first version uses the first and warns; same-second tie throws; none -> pending), resolves beneficiaries through the injected SnapshotBeneficiaryResolver port (in-memory fake only; real resolver blocked on identity B1-11a per orchestrator ruling A), takes reserve and each role's ratio from the chosen version's (platform, level, order_type) row (missing row -> pending, nothing written), splits only through @couli/domain splitCommission, and writes commission_splits plus version 1 of amounts / beneficiary_events / totals (BR-CALC-27 four segments) inside a SAVEPOINT. Replay returns existing; a concurrent duplicate (23505) rolls back to the savepoint and returns the existing snapshot. rebate_mode none zeroes all three shares (BR-CALC-19); time only from the injected Clock.
